summary.text: Cameron Cooper, a Republican, represents Arkansas House District 57, which includes portions of White, Lonoke and Faulkner counties, and is serving his fourth term.

paragraphs.text: He is a behavioral health consultant at Pathfinder, Inc., and owns and operates two small businesses, Cooper Farm and Cooper Lawn Care.
Cooper previously served seven terms as a White County Justice of the Peace, from 2005 to 2018.
He earned an Associate of Arts from Arkansas State University-Beebe and a Bachelor of Social Work and a Master of Science in Education from Harding University.
